newsitem.title: USA: Authorities identify another TWA victim.
newsitem.headline: Authorities identify another TWA victim.

text.p: Authorities said Tuesday they have identified the remains of another victim of TWA Flight 800, bringing the total number of victims identified to 215.
Using DNA testing, the Suffolk County Examiner's Office identified the remains as those of Judith Yee of New York City.

All 230 people on board died when the Paris-bound jet exploded without warning and crashed July 17 off the coast of Long Island, New York, just minutes after taking off from Kennedy International Airport.
The cause of the disaster has not been determined.
Investigators with the FBI and National Transportation Safety Board say they have three possible theories -- a bomb, a missile or mechanical failure -- but no definitive conclusion.
They believe the Boeing 747's centre fuel tank exploded, but say they do not know why.
